questions.story: 2026–27 ISU Grand Prix of Figure Skating > 2026 NHK Trophy
questions.question: American figure skater Ilia Malinin set a new men's short programme world record at which international competition in Japan?
questions.explanation: Ilia Malinin scored 114.81 points in the short programme at the NHK Trophy in Tokyo to break the previous record.
questions.context: 2026–27 ISU Grand Prix of Figure Skating > 2026 NHK Trophy: In figure skating, Ilia Malinin of the United States sets a men's short programme world record with 114.81 points at the NHK Trophy in Tokyo, Japan, surpassing compatriot Nathan Chen's previous record of 113.97 points set at the 2022 Winter Olympics.

questions.question: Which international low-cost airline saw its main operating subsidiary file for bankruptcy following a surge in jet fuel prices?
questions.explanation: Rising fuel expenses led the subsidiary of Norse Atlantic Airways to seek insolvency protection and halt flight operations.
questions.context: 2026 Iran war fuel crisis: Norwegian low-cost carrier Norse Atlantic Airways announces that its Norwegian operating subsidiary filed for bankruptcy after failing to secure short-term funding amid rising fuel costs, cancelling all flights and suspending ticket sales.

questions.question: Following special vote counting in New Zealand's election, which political group found itself holding a potential kingmaker position after the ruling coalition lost its majority?
questions.explanation: As the governing coalition fell to 65 seats, the Opportunity Party ended up in a position to determine the parliamentary majority.
questions.context: 2026 New Zealand general election: The counting of special votes results in the National Party losing two electorate seats, including one overhang seat. The National–ACT–NZ First coalition government falls below a majority to 65 seats, placing the Opportunity Party into a kingmaker position.

questions.question: An argument between drivers operating which mode of transport in Beirut escalated into a deadly street shootout?
questions.explanation: A dispute between minibus drivers in the Lebanese capital escalated into gunfire on the street.
questions.context: A shootout between minibus drivers after a quarrel on a street in Beirut, Lebanon, kills two people and injures three more.

questions.question: Which European nation officially entered a recession after its economy shrank for two quarters in a row?
questions.explanation: France experienced two consecutive quarters of economic contraction, resulting in a formal recession.
questions.context: France’s economy is contracted for two consecutive quarters and enters into a recession.
